evidence.quote: Altogether, inflation is still unacceptably high and must be our primary focus.
Thus, as we get closer to that uncertain destination, it would be prudent to move in smaller steps.
But rest assured, we will keep at it until the job is done.
But wage growth remains above what would be consistent with 2 percent inflation, given prevailing trends in productivity growth.
Consumer spending has remained resilient, however, supported by labor income growth and still-elevated savings.
Services prices more broadly have accelerated sharply this year and may prove to be a persistent factor keeping inflation elevated.
